title_zh: 按虚构信件表述反奴役观点

scenario.label_zh: 虚构历史信件展签的措辞
scenario.goal_zh: 核对作者反对奴役的观点并约定区分原文与展签概括

context_zh: 历史写作课：Lena 与 Omar 为教师创作的虚构历史信件写展签，不将其当作真实史料。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: The writer calls slavery a sin in this fictional letter. Should we leave that word in the display label?

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: If we quote it, yes. It shows how the writer expresses a moral objection.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: The next paragraph says officials tried to suppress letters like this one.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: Then our label can explain that opposition, but it shouldn’t claim everyone shared the same sentiment.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: I’ll use one short quotation and say that it records this writer’s view.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: That keeps the voice of the letter separate from our summary. Let’s do that.

targets.sense_zh: 宗教或道德意义上的罪恶
